definitions.explanation: A pipe that carries waste water away from sinks, toilets, bathtubs, and other fixtures. Found in homes, buildings, and municipal infrastructure.

{排水管|はいすいかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I asked a professional to clean the drainpipe.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{排水|はいすい}→排水：11104_haisui⟧ (drainage, draining water) + ⟦{管|かん}→管：09749_kan⟧ (pipe, tube). A practical household and construction term. {排水管|はいすいかん} problems like clogs and leaks are common topics when dealing with housing maintenance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {排水管|はいすいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}まる→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧: the drainpipe gets clogged
- {排水管|はいすいかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧: drain cleaning
- {排水管|はいすいかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧: drainpipe replacement
- {排水管|はいすいかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧: drainpipe repair
- {排水管|はいすいかん}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: drainage pipe work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {給水管|きゅうすいかん}: water supply pipe — carries clean water in, as opposed to waste water out
- {下水管|げすいかん}: sewer pipe — larger municipal pipes that carry sewage
- ⟦{排水口|はいすいこう}→排水口：16250_haisuikou⟧: drain opening — the drain hole in a sink, bathtub, or floor
